demand: Backend-to-backend event and queue impact across Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Pub/Sub.
identitySummary: Provider, broker namespace, destination kind, literal destination, and optional payload schema ID.
compatibilitySummary: Destination removal and bounded payload-schema changes are classified without network access.
evidenceRendering: Exact producer and consumer source locations, immutable content hashes, versions, activation, coverage, and remedy.
limitations: Dynamic destinations and broker namespaces remain unresolved and force partial coverage.
The adapter never contacts brokers, schema registries, cloud APIs, or source providers.
Payload compatibility is limited to the declared bounded schema subset.
